notes.title: Devlog | July Update & Demo Release!
notes.notes: [p][img src="https://lh7-rt.googleusercontent.com/docsz/AD_4nXeDtk7lMk1oCDlG1hKZGlvbl-5KfVUvigDcjDtgIXk_-ZJFpBHifGQd1PHnPcr1Yujpha2Gl-Emb-CbTdinao0wsl_C2RTdU5t4Xpgj9mG2L_7qHRusoDLsk47hhG5j5MnNpRx5Wg?key=9BtPgX_y4wXx17kk0V4KsQ"][/img][/p][p][/p][p]Hi everyone,  [/p][p]BIG NEWS: OUR DEMO IS OUT![/p][p]If you haven’t tried it yet, now’s a great time. And if you have, make sure to hop into our Discord to tell us what you think (or just to hang out).  [/p][p][img src="https://lh7-rt.googleusercontent.com/docsz/AD_4nXcW-cTeTaZtxiOKnnbWpP5iIkvAcA_81lAVKmrofDbqKBP5QOxN4Xc1ly5IxUt5OKB94clMLds3cE5XVVi0cwV41ZiavQHS-smlPcNAmKYxhjAf-EM_sgjwCJvpntr-1qiRo4a7zQ?key=9BtPgX_y4wXx17kk0V4KsQ"][/img][/p][p]Now for some recent-ish and super cool updates:[/p][p][/p][h1][b]Llama and Slime Bosses[/b][/h1][p]The long-awaited new bosses have arrived! [/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45160321/1bad156f2e402bb73d6cfc221197154128be9257.png"][/img][/p][p]They might look cute, but can you dodge their deadly fire meteors, ice pillars, revolving fireballs, projectiles, arm smashes, AND MORE? Sounds pretty difficult to us…[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45160321/4197d1d3567148e37ada8f755e262a5dc913db70.gif"][/img][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45160321/4ad08646a82fad62c113626d94eb3da4a1abfb12.gif"][/img][/p][p][/p][h1][b]Environment Color Theming[/b][/h1][p]We added some pizzazz as you progress through your run - map palettes now change depending on the round number.[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45160321/81804c8c037952f2f912dc9d311fcea0e31f7689.png"][/img][/p][h1][b]GIANT Shopkeeper[/b][/h1][p]The bigger the cat, the more magical. That’s just how it works.[/p][p]We also made their spawns more accessible![/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45160321/f548174f096d8ce703c6ea5058b32e9289c1eb18.gif"][/img][/p][p][/p][h1][b]Discovered by: YOU[/b][/h1][p]If you’re the first player to discover a new spell, your Steam ID now shows in its tooltip. [/p][p]Show off your wizarding skills - how many can you uncover?[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45160321/c37f4edc505ef20b6e24eebc75341182920eeeac.png"][/img][/p][p][/p][h1][b]Frog Mini Boss[/b][/h1][p]MINI boss but MEGA abilities.[/p][p][img src="https://lh7-rt.googleusercontent.com/docsz/AD_4nXdZh5NxaAN3Kc9AUQz8rv79XLOBIuyqmS8fgx_niC4dRdvl4uop9EpnFED06u63hEDN0OicBqHBk1LsjFRFPsLWfmmUmmyiB-62m-oOId5KtLmFeAZYIMLmwkeetdIsfqExVmJyug?key=9BtPgX_y4wXx17kk0V4KsQ"][/img][/p][p][/p][h1][b]Metaprogression[/b][/h1][p]Boss damage now scales over time.[/p][p]You can unlock new difficulty levels after beating Round 21:[/p][p]Novice → Apprentice → Initiate → Acolyte → Mage → Master Mage → Archmage[/p][p][/p][h1][b]Other New Features[/b][/h1][list][*][p][b]Monsters-Killed Gold Charge Bar:[/b] Kill thresholds at 20, 40, 60, and 80 percent of a round's total spawn power. Earn 1 gold per threshold. Kill 80 percent, get 4 gold.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Blink Spell:[/b] Teleporting Cat? Teleporting Cat.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Training Dummy: [/b]Spawns in the starting world and after each round ends.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Monster Spawn Indicator:[/b] No more jumpscares when enemies appear - indicators are now shown on the ground.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Key Bindings: [/b]Fully customizable in the options menu.[/p][/*][*][p][b]UI Animations: [/b]Made the UI more interactive and intuitive! For example, when you pick up an arcana, there is a glowing animation around your arcana equip slots. Our favorite is the slot-up animation, which teases you a bit if it fails.[b] [/b][/p][p][/p][/*][/list][p]Thanks as always for following our development - stay tuned for more awesome updates! [/p]

notes.title: Devlog | June Update
notes.notes:
[p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45160321/d4562601eb735514abbd47e75f95737e4e3210a1.gif"][/img][/p][p]Hey everyone, excited to start sharing regular dev updates here on Steam! Here are some highlights from the last couple months.
[/p][h2][b]Frog King Boss[/b][/h2][p]Introducing our first boss, the Frog King Boss! Kill him before he slams you with his belly.[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45160321/6a56eabe8ae558e87ae3a811df4a814f1e528675.gif"][/img][/p][h2][b]Buff Frog Enemy[/b][/h2][p]New enemy! Buff frog who charges at you, thick boy walks with confidence…[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45160321/32f533aa0c9f51757ff41566c90d34f04ccb8894.gif"][/img][/p][h2][b]Combined Inventory, Crafting, and Shop View[/b][/h2][p]A piece of feedback from playtesters was improving the UI, making it more intuitive with more info in tooltips.[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45160321/641d5f277c359d6b9f50ad9977085795149d7eda.png"][/img][/p][h2][b]Twin Stick Movement[/b][/h2][p]We’ve upgraded movement system to twin stick movement, combat feels quite a bit smoother now![/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45160321/ac93c158d923e749ea1796ee7d57f666134920e0.gif"][/img][/p][p][/p][h2][b]New Arcana and Balance Updates[/b][/h2][p]Some of the arcana we added to encourage new builds and also address some feedback about a shortage of early game arcana:[/p][list][*][p][b]Voltanic eruption[/b]: +5% increased fire damage for every lightning strike spawned in the past 5 seconds[/p][/*][*][p][b]Coin clicker[/b]: gain 1 gold at end of round for every 3 times this spell is cast (max 5 gold)[/p][/*][*][p][b]Single target[/b]: 100% increased damage, but this halves every time the spell damages a new target[/p][/*][*][p][b]Flameo[/b]: on cast, other spells gain +15 base fire damage for the next 10 seconds. does not stack[/p][/*][*][p][b]Re-ignite/re-charge/re-freeze[/b]: -1 fire/lightning/ice reduced mana cost[/p][/*][/list][p]Also nerfed several existing arcana and other balance updates, [b]shout out to all of our early playtesters[/b] for letting us know where we need to make adjustments!
[/p][h1][b]What’s Next[/b][/h1][list][*][p]Metaprogression[/p][/*][*][p]Two Headed Llama and Giant Slime bosses[/p][/*][*][p]More UI improvements[/p][/*][*][p]Blink spells[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][p]Thanks for following development, stay tuned for more updates![/p]

notes.title: Frequently Asked Questions (FAQ) – Wizard Cats
notes.notes:
[b]What is Wizard Cats?[/b]
[b][i]Wizard Cats[/i][/b] is an innovative roguelite dungeon crawler featuring a groundbreaking spellcrafting system. Take on the role of a cat thrown into a magical realm, where you must craft powerful spells to survive and conquer ever-changing challenges.

[b]How does the spellcrafting system work?[/b]
[i][b]Wizard Cats[/b][/i] allows you to combine up to seven runes, each with unique properties, to create spells. These spells can then be modified using Arcana and Power Shards, leading to over 100 billion possible spell combinations! The game’s spell engine dynamically interprets spell combinations, creating unique effects on the fly.

[b]Does [i]Wizard Cats[/i] use generative AI?[/b]
None of the art in [i][b]Wizard Cats[/b][/i] is generated using AI—all of the art is hand-drawn by our talented team of artists. The game features an advanced AI-driven spell engine that dynamically interprets rune combinations in real time, allowing players to craft completely unique spells without predefined formulas. Players can create over 100 billion possible spells, with the AI writing the code to power these spells on the fly—sometimes leading to unpredictable outcomes. This intelligent system also enables enemies to learn and use player-created spells, meaning that the magic you wield today could be turned against you tomorrow. Additionally, the AI ensures that spell synergies behave logically yet dynamically, making each playthrough a fresh experience where creativity and adaptation are key to mastering the arcane arts. 

[b]Can I create my own spells?[/b]
Yes! The game’s spell engine allows you to experiment with different rune combinations to create never-before-seen spells. If you are the first to create a specific spell, your name will be immortalized in the game’s spell compendium for others to see!

[b]What kind of art style does the game have?[/b]
[i][b]Wizard Cats[/b][/i] features vibrant, hand-drawn pixel art. Every character and environment has been carefully crafted to create an enchanting and immersive world.

[b]When is [i]Wizard Cats[/i] releasing?[/b]
[i][b]Wizard Cats[/b][/i] is set to launch later this year on Steam. Keep an eye on official announcements for the exact release date.

[b]How can I stay updated on the game?[/b]
You can follow [i][b]Wizard Cats[/b][/i]’ development on [url=https://discord.gg/wizardcats]Discord[/url] and wishlist the game on [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/3176500/Wizard_Cats/]Steam[/url] to receive updates and announcements.

[b]Where can I play [i]Wizard Cats[/i]?[/b]
[i][b]Wizard Cats[/b][/i] will be available on [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/3176500/Wizard_Cats/]Steam[/url] at launch. Additional platform availability may be announced in the future.
